item.title: Earthquake of magnitude 6.7 strikes East Coast of Aomori Prefecture, Japan
item.description: In Japan, an earthquake of magnitude 6.7 hit the east coast of Aomori Prefecture this morning. The Japan Meteorological Agency said that the earthquake occurred approximately 120 kilometres south-southwest of Cape Erimo at a depth of approximately 20 kilometres. Following this, the agency issued tsunami alerts and said it is dangerous to be in the ocean or near the coast. item.title: 4 inspectors who oversee IndiGo flight ops sacked from DGCA after mass cancellations
item.description: Four Flight Operations Inspectors (FOIs) have been sacked from their post at the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) amid the ongoing IndiGo flight cancellations crisis. “Contracts of these FOIs with the DGCA have been terminated in relation to the recent IndiGo crisis,” an official said, citing the order dated December 11. item.description: The Madhya Pradesh government late on Thursday removed Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer Santosh Verma as deputy secretary (agriculture) and recommended his dismissal to the central government, citing forged documents he allegedly used for his elevation from the state administrative service. item.title: Gujarat becomes fourth-largest potato producer in India, sowing up by 13% this season
item.description: Gujarat is poised for a strong potato harvest this year, with sowing rising by 13% during the ongoing Rabi season. The state now contributes 40–50 lakh tonnes to India’s total annual potato output of around 600 lakh tonnes, placing it fourth after Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal and Bihar. India remains the world’s second-largest potato producer after China. item.title: ACC Under-19 Asia Cup 2025 begins in Dubai
item.description: The Asian Cricket Council (ACC) Under-19 Asia Cup 2025 began in Dubai this morning. In the opening match of the tournament, hosts United Arab Emirates (UAE) won the toss and invited Ayush Mhatre led India to bat first. The match is being played at the ICC Academy Ground in Dubai. item.title: Tere Ishk Mein Box Office 2nd Week: Dhanush and Kriti Sanon starrer enters Rs 100 crore club
item.description: Tere Ishk Mein recorded a fair hold against Ranveer Singh starrer Dhurandhar in the second week. The movie added Rs. 23.05 crore to the tally, against the new release, with roughly Rs. 1.60 crore net coming on its second Thursday. The drop from the first week is around 70 percent, which is a significant dip. However, considering the kind of momentum Dhurandhar has picked up post its opening day, Tere Ishk Mein has held very well. The Dhanush and Kriti Sanon starrer crossed the Rs. 100 crore mark

item.title: Silver prices can rally 20% to Rs 240,000/kg in 2026: Axis Securities
item.description: Silver prices that hit Rs 200,000-per-kilogram (kg) milestone in India on Friday have more room to climb, suggests a note from Axis Securities.
